source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
2. Gather all the necessary details: Date and time of the accident, location within the workplace, a precise description of the incident, names and positions of all involved parties, including witnesses, and the nature of any injuries sustained. 

3. Fill out the incident report form, ensuring all sections are completed thoroughly and accurately. Include a detailed narrative that describes the sequence of events leading up to the accident, the accident itself, and any immediate aftermath.

4. Document any visible injuries or damages with photographs if possible. Ensure photos are taken from multiple angles and include close-ups and wide shots to provide context.

5. Conduct witness interviews and document their statements. Make sure each witness’s account is recorded accurately and impartially, noting any discrepancies or unique insights.

6. Obtain copies of medical reports for injured employees. Ensure privacy laws are respected when handling confidential health records.

7. Secure any damaged equipment or materials involved in the accident. Document the condition of these items
